h1: Backorders and pre-orders, set up and managed
overview: We set up your store to take orders for items that are not in stock yet, and make sure customers know what they are buying. That covers clear delivery dates on the product page, honest messages in the cart and emails, the right payment timing and a waiting list. We test the full journey with a sample order, and we help you handle each batch of stock when it arrives, so the oldest orders ship first.

faq: Is it legal to charge for items that are not ready?
Rules differ by country. We help you set clear dates and wording, and follow platform and payment provider rules. You remain responsible for your own consumer law, so check local rules with a lawyer.
What happens if the stock is delayed?
We write delay emails ahead of time, so customers are told early. They can wait or ask to cancel, and the refund steps are already clear.
Do I need an app for pre-orders?
Some platforms handle backorders themselves, and others need an app. We choose the simplest option for your platform and tell you the cost first.
Can I mix pre-order and in-stock items in one cart?
Yes, although it affects shipping. We set up your store to either ship together later or split the order, whichever you prefer, and we test it.
